Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 11, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Chambers Room 9th Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Arturo Salazar, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on August 28, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Terilyn Ferguson – Profitt on behalf of Girl Scouts of Greater Los Angeles to host a Fall
  Product Program and Cookie Program Event in Inglewod; Scouts residing in Inglewood; will
  do walkabouts in their neighborhood / sell at the approved storefronts; public property; on
  Tuesday, September 30, 2025, through Sunday, November 23, 2025, from 8:00 a.m. – 8:00
  p.m; and Sunday, February 1, 2026 through Sunday, March 29,2026, APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for an event to sell at various locations. Subject to all applicable
  IMC regulations; Applicant; Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire a minimum of 6
  professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees. Security staff shall monitor
  the restrooms being utilized by attendees to deter any outside lewd conduct activity. None
  Code Enforcement conditions;No additional requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at
  all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activty No. 00406379)
 Permits & License Committee  September 11, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

Item #2:  Betty Luckett on behalf of From The Heart Preschool to host a Harvest Festival Event at 1061
  E. Hyde Park Blvd; Public Property; on Friday, October 31, 2025, from 3:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event on Long Street between
  Hyde Park Blvd and Fairview Blvd. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the
  right-of-way Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; pproved; Applicant to hire two (2) TCO
  for street closure & traffic safety. NOTE: This street is narrow enough for TCO cars to block
  vehicular traffic, Meridian Barriers maybe required (TBA); Applicant must hire a minimum of
  two (2) professional-licensed security guards -OR- off-duty law enforcement parents for the
  safety of attendees. Security personnel shall wear reflective vests for high visibility. IPD
  watch commander will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time
  permits; No additional requirements for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activty No. 00406343)
